reviews.review:
There is just too much wrong with this game to ever recommend it. I honestly don't know how it has a "mostly positive" review.

1. To start off with my least 'impactful" issue: The writing is TERRIBLE. Not only are the responses something close to what a 12 year old would say, but none of the "lingo" is correct. It's almost like the developer has never seen any kind of war movie or anything in "action". Instead of saying over and out, it's just "end of communications". There is no code (10-4), there is no military alphabet(Tango), and it's filled with "Free will fire" instead of, what i assume would have been "open fire, free to engage" etc.
2. Next is... there is no research or base building, it's just a straight up linear game where each mission you get access to something "new" but it's nothing to really be excited about.
3. Aliens.... They use OUR WEAPONS. I don't know if I am the only one that is bothered so much by that, but why is this alien creature running around with a freaking AK that my soldiers use? I mean... it's just such a lack of foresight or really just laziness in terms of story and progression.
4. Reloading takes WAY too much AP (Action Points). You get 18 per soldier, and reloading is often 13-15 AP. Meaning if you reload, you cannot shoot, move, or really do anything but reload. The point of magazines and the pouches on armor is to make reloading faster and easier.
5. Each class gets about the same kind of skills or share ones like "counter attack", or sharing of drones.
6. You don't get access to more troops, you get these four people and they each need their own specialization.
7. The sniper gun is weird, the SVD falls behind a "special sub machinegun" in terms of distance and accuracy, but still does the same damage. I'm sorry, no 9mm gun is going to out range a freaking 7.62 bullet, and will definitely not out damage a 7.62 bullet.
8. The animations are really off... your guys will keep shooting the gun as they stop aiming to put the gun back at their side/pointing at the ground.

There is just nothing in this game that makes me want to play past the 6 missions I have already done. Each mission is going to feel exactly the same way.  You don't get any kind of cool weapons from the aliens, you don't get any research, you really have nothing that drives you to want to do the next mission. Nothing in this game is even "good", it's just "Bleh".
